utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning to you all. Mr. Registrar, can you kindly call the case for today, please. I apologise, it's not a women -- not a man, but a woman.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honour, case number IT-04-82-A, The Prosecutor versus Ljube Boskoski and Johan Tarculovski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Tarculovski, can you hear and follow our proceedings in a language you understand? THE ACCUSED TARCULOVSKI: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to turn to the parties and ask them if we can have the appearance, please. Let us start with the Prosecution. MS. MARTIN SALGADO: Good morning, Your Honour. Elena Martin Salgado appearing for the Prosecution, and with me is Nicole Lewis, and our case manager, Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Mr. Boskoski, Guenael Mettraux, co-counsel. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: And Nathan Dershowitz appearing by telephone on behalf of Mr. Tarculovski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Thank you very much. I shall now check and see whether the videolink is working properly. Mr. Dershowitz, can you hear and follow these proceedings? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. That's fine. Thank you. This Status Conference has been convened pursuant to Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal. That requires that a Status Conference be organised within 120 days of the filing of a notice of appeal. The main purpose of a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. We are meeting for the first time today. The Trial Chamber handed down its Judgement in this case on the 10th of July, 2008. On the 30th of July 2008, the president of the Tribunal issued an order designating the Judges that would sit on appeal. Namely, Judge Pocar, Judge Shahabuddeen, Jude Vaz, Judge Liu, and Judge Meron. In the order of 11th November 2008, I have been assigned to replace Judge Pocar. After having been elected Presiding Judge in this case, I appointed myself Pre-Trial Judge on appeal on 17th of November 2008. Let me specify that the OTP filed its notice of appeal on the 6th of August 2008. And Mr. Tarculovski's Defence counsel filed its notice of appeal on the 8th of August 2008. I would like to address the conditions in detention and the state of health of Mr. Tarculovski. Mr. Tarculovski, do you wish to raise any concerns you may have regarding to your conditions in detention or to your state of health, be it mental or physical? THE ACCUSED TARCULOVSKI: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, I have nothing to raise. Everything is in good order.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may sit down. Let me now remind you, the schedule for the filing of submissions on appeal. The OTP filed its confidential appeals brief on the 20th October 2008, As well as a redacted of this version on the 3rd of November, and a corrected and redacted version on 4th November 2008. The response brief for Mr. Boskoski Defence must be filed today. Can Mr. Boskoski Defence counsel confirm that the brief in response will be filed today.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... filed in the course of today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much for your cooperation. Let me remind you that once a brief of the respondent has been filed, the appellant has two weeks to file a brief in reply, pursuant to Rule 113 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. The OTP has until the 16th of December 2008 to file a brief in response, if need be. Now, as far as the respondent's brief and Mr. Tarculovski Defence counsel is concerned, let me remind you that a decision was handed down by the Appeals Chamber on the 22nd of October 2008 that stated that this brief should be filed by the 12th of January, 2008 [as interpreted]. In this respect I would like to emphasise that the translation services of this Tribunal confirmed on Friday that the translation handed down by the Trial Chamber will be completed today, the translation into Macedonian. Once all the submissions on appeal have been filed, the Trial Chamber will then decide how to proceed and set the date of the hearing on appeal. I would like to ask the parties if, at this stage, they have any questions they would like to raise during this Status Conference. Let me first turn to the representatives of the OTP. MS. MARTIN SALGADO: I don't have any issues to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Does Mr. Tarculovski Defence counsel wish to raise any particular issue? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: Yes, Your Honour, there is Nathan Dershowitz. I'm just curious as to whether the two matters will continue to be -- to proceed together. And, if so, I do not believe that I ever received a -- formally a copy of the OTP submission, and I would imagine that, if they are to be handled together, that I probably should receive a formal copy of that submission, as well as a formal copy of the submission by the appellant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I shall now give the floor to the representatives of the OTP. MS. MARTIN SALGADO: Your Honour, I believe that may be a matter for the registry. In our submissions on appeal, Mr. Dershowitz is copied in the cover page, so he should have received a copy.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. ... [previous translation continues] ... that you hear the reply given by the OTP. Does it satisfy you? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: I will have to check in my office today, and I will get back to the registrar if I am correct that I did not receive copies.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much, and thank you for your cooperation. I would like to turn to Mr. Dershowitz. I hope you heard my question. I shall repeat it for you. At this juncture do you have any question that you would like to raise during this status conference? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: No, I do not, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me now turn to Defence counsel of Mr. Boskoski. Do you wish to raise any particular issue at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour, there are two very brief matters which we would like to address if we may. The first one pertains to the dates or the likely dates of the appeals hearing in this matter. And we understand that the Appeals Chamber may not be in a position --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: One moment, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: I apologise for this interruption. You may proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. The first matter, and very briefly, pertains to the date or the likely date of the appeals hearing in this matter. We understand that the Appeals Chamber at this stage my not be in a position to give us an indication of the approximate date of the appeals hearing, but on behalf of Mr. Boskoski, we would wish to indicate that it would be our wish that an appeals hearing in this matter should take place as soon as practicable. And we would be grateful to the Appeals Chamber if that indication could be taken into consideration. The second matter, briefly, Your Honour, pertains to the disclosure. And thanks to the cooperation of the Prosecution, it has been resolved before the hearing. We were being given an indication that as far as the Prosecution could tell, they had disclosed all remaining or outstanding material that was to be disclosed on the understanding, obviously, that their obligation is in that regard is ongoing. That is all for us. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. As I have already mentioned, it is now too soon and a little premature to set the date of the hearing on appeal. In order to do that, the filing of all the submissions need to be complete. As far as your second issue is concerned, I'm happy to hear that disclosure pursuant to Rule 68 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence has been completed. If there are any outstanding documents, I hope this will be disclosed as soon as possible. As far as I am concerned, I have no other issue to raise. And I believe therefore that we can adjourn for today. I would like to thank all the parties for being present, as well as the staff of the Tribunal, that has helped us organise this Status Conference. The hearing stands adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
